steps.name: the runner really is a graphical login session
open a document in TextEdit
steps.comment: Detached on purpose: `activate` blocks until the app answers an Apple Event, and a cold launch on a 3-core runner takes longer than the request timeout.
steps.exec: (osascript -e 'tell application "TextEdit" to activate' -e 'tell application "TextEdit" to make new document' >/dev/null 2>&1 &); sleep 12; echo launched

steps.name: the document window really exists
steps.exec: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to count windows of process "TextEdit"'

steps.name: both lines landed, so Return was not swallowed
steps.exec: osascript -e 'tell application "TextEdit" to get text of document 1' | tr '\r' '\n' | grep -c . | tr -d ' '
